title: The Quarantined Convoy
logline: An exhausted refugee leader needs a pilot to break through a military blockade that has trapped their fleet in a dying star system.

roles.description: Running on fumes, deeply responsible for their people.
A massive orbital gate heavily fortified with guns.
A heavy cruiser enforcing the blockade.
A flotilla of civilian ships barely holding together.

public_situation: The {role:refugee_fleet} has been stopped at the {role:border_checkpoint} for mandatory health inspections.
private_truth: The inspections are a sham. The local governor ordered the fleet delayed in the dying star system until they simply run out of air.

beats.public_change: The refugee fleet's life support reserves drop to critical levels.

missions.reason: The leader asks the pilot to scan the checkpoint's processing queue to see when they will be allowed through.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the queue has been frozen for a week; no one is being processed.

missions.reason: The leader begs the player to dock and collect a desperate physical plea to smuggle out to the capital.
missions.private_fact: The letter contains highly infectious blood samples meant to prove they aren't sick with the official plague.

beats.public_change: A solar flare damages one of the refugee ships, causing panic.

missions.reason: The leader begs the pilot to mine and deliver water_ice to the fleet waiting at the checkpoint.
missions.private_fact: The guard intercepts the delivery and tries to confiscate it.

missions.reason: The guard hires the player to buy heavy plasma barricades and deliver them to the checkpoint to hold the fleet back.
missions.private_fact: The barricades are actually automated turrets designed to shoot on sight.

beats.public_change: The border guard begins actively turning ships around, forcing them deeper into the dying star system.

missions.reason: The guard hires the pilot to collect the fleet's navigation logs to prove they are trying to bypass the checkpoint.
missions.private_fact: The logs actually prove the fleet has been patiently waiting the entire time.

beats.public_change: The refugee leader orders the fleet to forcefully run the blockade.

missions.reason: The leader pays the pilot to attack the guard patrol and clear a path for the fleet.
missions.private_fact: The guard hails the pilot, offering full amnesty and a massive bounty if they destroy the leader's ship instead.

resolutions.summary: The refugee fleet punches through the blockade and escapes the dying star. The military is humiliated.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broke a military blockade to save a dying refugee fleet.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the guard's offer.
resolutions.summary: The leader is killed. The fleet surrenders and is forced back into the dying star system, where most slowly perish.
The fleet's desperate charge fails. The military destroys several ships, and the rest succumb to the dying star's radiation.

loose_threads.detail: The blockade orders were signed by a shadowy mega-corporation, not the border administrator.
The star isn't dying naturally; it's being harvested by a massive, unseen megastructure.

radio_hooks: Tensions rise at {role:border_checkpoint} as refugee fleet is held indefinitely.
{role:border_guard} insists quarantine protocols are for everyone's safety.

voice_direction.exhausted_leader: Deep, tired, speaks slowly to conserve energy.
